recommendations: Recommend structured lifestyle program aiming for >= 7-10% weight loss
Screen for metabolic risk factors: diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia
Consider liver biopsy or transient elastography (FibroScan) to stage fibrosis
Consider pharmacotherapy with pioglitazone or GLP-1 RA in patients with biopsy-proven NASH and type 2 diabetes

follow_up.action: Refer to hepatologist for diagnostic workup and non-invasive staging
Assess weight loss progress and liver enzymes (ALT, AST)
Re-evaluate metabolic parameters and adherence to lifestyle plan
Screen for hepatocellular carcinoma using abdominal ultrasound if cirrhosis is present

contraindications.action: Contraindicated due to risk of fluid retention

emergency_signs: Decompensated cirrhosis signs: hematemesis, melena, abdominal distension (ascites), confusion or drowsiness (hepatic encephalopathy), jaundice
references: AASLD Practice Guidance on the Clinical Assessment and Management of Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
